Recently, there are always people asking me: is it a bull market or a bear market now?

To be honest, when I first entered the cryptocurrency world, I was like everyone else, not really believing in the "four-year cycle" theory that the veterans keep talking about.

I always felt they were just trying to scare newcomers. But until I personally witnessed Bitcoin drop from 126,000 to 94,000, and altcoins were even worse, many directly dropping by 70-80%, I truly understood: whether it's a bull or bear market isn't just shouted out, it's shown through the drops.

Just last month, during the time Bitcoin was hovering around 110,000, the market was simply crazy.

Various meme coins could increase five to ten times in a day, and everyone was in high spirits, as if any purchase would lead to profits.

In fact, I had reminded about the risks back then, but many laughed at me, calling me a "bearish trader", too pessimistic.

Bitcoin at least has some institutional funds supporting it, but once altcoins have no one to take over, they can only keep falling.

From a technical perspective, both the 200-day and 365-day moving averages have broken down, and now everyone is focused on whether the 72,000 line can hold.

Not to mention, the expectation of the Federal Reserve lowering interest rates has fallen through, and the government is facing a risk of shutdown, making market liquidity increasingly tight.

If at this time you still expect some Christmas rally by the end of the year, I advise you, it's time to see reality clearly.

So how do we view the year-end market? My judgment is very simple: it's highly likely to oscillate between 80,000 and 90,000.

If Bitcoin really breaks below 80,000, then this round of the bull market is basically declared over.
However, that being said, a bull market won't just keep rising, and a bear market won't forever fall.

When the market reaches its extreme, there will definitely be a reversal. The position we are in now is not the end, but the beginning of the next cycle.

So, rather than getting tangled every day about whether it's a bull or bear market, it's better to calm down:
Maintain a light position, keep some bullets in hand, and don’t easily bet on direction.

Only those with patience can smile until the end.

🛑 FALSE BREAKOUT ALERT: Stop Chasing, Start Confirming!

The most cunning move in the market is the 'false breakout' (Fakeout), and it's specifically designed to liquidate the impatient. Right now, $ETH is testing key resistance/support zones, making these traps an extreme risk. Don't be the liquidity for the Whales!
This is where the amateur mindset of "apeing in" gets punished. True pro traders know that a "break" is just a data point—not a trade signal.
The Pro-Trader Playbook for $ETH Fakeouts:
Wait for the Close (The Candle Confirmation): Never enter on a wick or mid-candle spike. A genuine breakout must close and hold beyond the key level, ideally on the daily or 4-hour chart. A close back inside the previous range is your clear signal for a Bull or Bear Trap.
Volume is Your Veto Power: Low volume on the breakout candle is the single biggest red flag for a fakeout. A true move, especially in a major like $ETH, must be backed by a massive surge in volume. No volume, no validity.
The Multi-Timeframe Check: A breakout on a 5-minute chart can be a fakeout on the 1-hour chart. Zoom out! Confirm the move aligns with the prevailing trend on the higher timeframes (e.g., Daily).
Master this principle: A false breakout is not a failed trade; it's a high-probability reversal entry for the savvy contrarian.
Your Insight: If you don't use confirmation tools, you're not trading the trend; you're chasing the trap.

I can only say you are still at the first level, which is the layer of retail investors. Don't the major players see these benefits? Just like the crash after the approval of ETFs, it's not that prices won't rise, but at this time point in December, the more visible benefits there are, the more cautious you need to be. Because there are traps everywhere. Moreover, the maximum interest rate cut is just 25 basis points. If interest rate cuts could lead to a rise, then after two months of cumulative cuts of 50 basis points, there should have already been a significant rise. The reality is that there hasn't been; why? Because there are too many people going long, all trying to capitalize on the visible benefits. The major players are not doing charity; how could they push the market up to let you profit?

Good afternoon, brothers!
Yesterday I shared a simple example about the simple determination of a bull market, but since the current market is not within a bull market cycle, I feel that it does not provide a good reference for the current market analysis. In fact, a bear market corresponds to a bull market, which is a completely opposite existence; the trend direction is entirely opposite, and the K-line trends are also opposite, but the rhythm is similar!
Illustration: Continuously moving down at a low position, after a pullback, continuing to hit new lows!
A significant drop triggered panic selling, then a rebound hit stop-losses of short positions, continuing to drop further to hit stop-losses of bottom-fishing positions, repeating several times until the market stabilizes, those caught in losing positions lie flat and play dead, and after retail investors stop paying attention, institutions begin to enter by absorbing through low-level oscillation and sideways trading (to be analyzed in depth next time).

title: ⚠️ A Major Financial Wave Is Building - And 2026 Is the Breaking Point
subTitle:
Hear this clearly: something big is coming in 2026.
Not a normal recession. Not a simple banking issue.
This time, the pressure is sitting inside the global bond system the foundation of all financial markets.

And the first warning sign is already flashing:
📉 The MOVE Index is rising  bond volatility is waking up.
Right now, three global pressure points are tightening together:

1️⃣ U.S. Treasury funding stress
2️⃣ Japan’s yen & carry-trade imbalance
3️⃣ China’s overloaded credit system

Any one of these could shake global markets…
All three hitting together in 2026?
👉 That’s when the system cracks.

🇺🇸 The Fastest-Building Risk: A U.S. Treasury Funding Shock
In 2026, the U.S. must issue record levels of debt — exactly when:
❌ Deficits are exploding
❌ Interest costs are rising
❌ Foreign buyers are stepping back
❌ Dealers are stretched thin
❌ Auction strength is weakening

This is exactly how the U.K. gilt crisis began in 2022 - except this time it’s not one country… it’s the whole world.

Why does this matter?
Because Treasuries control everything:
🏠 mortgages
🏢 corporate credit
🌎 global FX
💵 emerging markets
🔁 repo & collateral
📉 risk assets

If long-term yields spike → the entire system shakes.

🇯🇵 Japan Amplifies the Shock
Japan is the biggest foreign buyer of U.S. Treasuries.
If USD/JPY shoots to 160–180:
⚡ BOJ must intervene
⚡ Carry trades unwind
⚡ Japanese pensions sell foreign bonds
⚡ Treasury volatility jumps even higher

Japan doesn’t just get hit —
👉 it multiplies the global shock.

🇨🇳 China: The Silent Second Amplifier
China is sitting on a $9–11 trillion debt bubble in local financing.
A single major failure could trigger:
💥 Yuan drop
💥 EM panic
💥 Commodity spikes
💥 Dollar surge
💥 U.S. yields jump again
Now you have three shock waves feeding each other.

🔥 What Triggers the 2026 Event?
➡️ A weak U.S. 10-year or 30-year Treasury auction
Just one bad auction could cause:
📈 Yields to spike
📉 Liquidity to vanish
💵 Dollar to rip upward
🌍 Global funding to tighten
📉 Risk assets to fall fast

That’s the start.
📉 Phase 1: The Funding Shock
During the first wave:
📈 Long-term yields explode upward
💵 Dollar surges
🌫️ Liquidity disappears
🇯🇵 Japan intervenes
🇨🇳 Offshore yuan drops
📉 Credit spreads widen
🪙 Bitcoin & tech pull back hard
🥈 Silver lags gold
📉 Stocks fall 20–30%

This part hits fast — like 2019 repo shock, but bigger.

💧 Then Central Banks Step In
To stabilize the system, expect:
💦 Liquidity injections
🔄 Swap lines
🏦 Treasury buybacks
📉 Temporary curve control (if needed)

This calms markets…
but floods them with liquidity.
That’s when Phase 2 begins.

🚀 Phase 2: The Opportunity of the Decade
As real yields collapse:
🥇 Gold breaks out
🥈 Silver leads the rally
🪙 Bitcoin recovers
🛢️ Commodities surge
💵 Dollar peaks & rolls over

This is the start of the 2026–2028 inflation wave.

📌 Why Everything Points to 2026
Because multiple global cycles all hit their peak at the same time.
And the signals are already blinking:

⚡ MOVE Index rising
⚡ USD/JPY stretched
⚡ Yuan weakening
⚡ 10-year yields pushing higher

When these move together → the countdown begins.

🟢 Final Takeaway
The world can survive a recession.
But it cannot survive a disorderly Treasury market.

2026 is when the pressure finally breaks —
first with a funding shock,then with the strongest hard-asset bull market of the decade.

Brothers who survived the liquidation price of 79,000 really should engage less in contracts.

Even A9 level individuals can't withstand leverage; most people do not have stable and continuous cash flow, let alone play this game. Over the years in the cryptocurrency circle, I've seen too many geniuses. Some earn billions in a year through rebates, some step by step reach the top by hitting the early benefits, some become market leaders by making a market, some rise to big shots in the gray market, and some change their lives with a spark of coding inspiration. But I really haven't seen many who made money through contracts and ultimately stood at the pinnacle.

However, I've seen too many A8 and A9 level players who fell from their peaks to bankruptcy due to one explosion of leverage. Contracts are not opportunities; they are hell, and coming back once is already a miracle.

This time you’ve managed to withstand it, so maybe lower your position a bit. Be part of the market structure, rather than continuing to gamble and muddle through life.

Of course, people in subculture circles can endure hardships and naturally enjoy the thrill of zero-sum games. If they lose, they can only go become cattle and horses, grazing for a lifetime. But the problem is, even grazing should involve some nutritious grass, right?

Gamblers live by luck; the strong live by structure and cognition.

Since you can come back from a liquidation price of 79,000, it shows you don't need to be a gambler anymore.

title: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Buys Another 14,618 ETH as Institutional Interest in Ethereum Surges
subTitle:
Bitmine Immersion Technologies (NYSE American: BMNR) continues to expand its massive Ethereum holdings. According to on-chain analytics platforms, the company added 14,618 ETH on Friday—at a time when institutional demand is rapidly accelerating and spot Ethereum ETFs in the U.S. are seeing renewed inflows.

Bitmine Immersion Adds 14,618 ETH Worth Over $44 Million 
Onchain Lens reported on November 28 that the latest transfer originated from a BitGo hot wallet, delivering 14,618 ETH valued at $44.34 million directly into Bitmine’s reserves.
This purchase lifts the company’s total Ethereum holdings to approximately 3.6 million ETH, which accounts for roughly 3% of the entire circulating supply. According to Yahoo Finance, Bitmine Immersion has a corporate valuation of $12.19 billion, with cryptocurrency reserves totaling $11.2 billion, giving the company an mNAV of 1.08.
These acquisitions come at a time when large U.S. asset managers are once again moving aggressively into ETH through approved spot ETFs.

Institutions Are Buying Again – BlackRock and Fidelity Lead New ETF Inflows
Late November brought a surge of institutional activity. Both BlackRock and Fidelity recorded significant inflows into their spot Ethereum ETFs earlier in the week, just before U.S. markets paused for the Thanksgiving holiday.
Meanwhile, Bitmine Immersion has been aggressively accumulating ETH:
Earlier this week, the firm bought 28,625 ETH worth $82.11 million.One day prior, it acquired 21,537 ETH valued at $60 million from FalconX.
Altogether, Bitmine has purchased more than 64,000 ETH within just a few days—reflecting a very bullish accumulation strategy aligned with Tom Lee’s long-term positive stance on Ethereum.

BMNR Stock Surges as Institutional Holdings Jump Tenfold
Shares of Bitmine Immersion have reacted sharply to the recent activity.

On Wednesday, BMNR closed:
+9.79% at $31.74followed by an additional +3.65% in after-hours trading.
Institutional ownership has also increased dramatically: what was 10 million shares a month ago has now exploded to 100 million shares, signaling intense interest in both the company and the Ethereum ecosystem.

Ethereum Holds Above $3,000 as Market Awaits Option Expiry
Ethereum is currently trading at $3,019, reflecting almost 15% growth in the past week.

The 24-hour range sits between $2,987 and $3,043.

Trading volume over the past day has dropped by 31%, suggesting caution as the market prepares for today’s major ETH options expiry.

Conclusion
Bitmine Immersion Technologies is aggressively expanding its Ethereum position at a moment when institutional investors are returning to the asset in force.

Strong ETF inflows, rising institutional ownership, and increasingly favorable technical indicators all suggest that Ethereum may be entering a new phase of growth.

$TRADOOR  A single order exploded with 100,000 U, does it hurt? It should hurt. As the saying goes, if you don't listen to advice, you can only eat half-cooked rice. Fan Xiao Deng, asked me in the background when TRADOOR was positioned at 1.3, already experiencing a floating loss of 50,000 U. I told him it should continue to rise, and advised him to cut losses and go against it. Yet he was entangled with half of the position missing. Insisting on waiting a bit longer, he said that when he turned to the square, many people were bearish. What's the difference between placing an order at the square and a blind man touching an elephant? As a result, he just cried to me, Feige, I blew up my account, it's all gone..

#ETH  Many people ask me: How many times should perpetual contracts be opened? To be honest, I've been asked this question endlessly over the past ten years. Newbies, veterans, and big players have all faced setbacks with leverage.
You need to understand—leverage is not a tool for getting rich; it’s a double-edged sword. Used well, it accelerates; used poorly, it grinds you down.
Perpetual contracts do not expire; as long as you don't blow up your account, you can hold on indefinitely.
It sounds free, but behind that freedom is temptation: you can enter and exit anytime, you can renew indefinitely, you can amplify your profits—
Of course, the risks are also infinitely amplified.

#BTC  Yesterday, a crypto friend said he was using 30-50 times leverage. I asked him why he didn't use 100 times, and he said it blew up too quickly. I laughed because as long as you use leverage, no matter how many times, you are on the edge of a knife; the difference is just how much reaction time the market gives you.
For example: for BTC, 30 times requires 16 U, 50 times 10 U, and 100 times 5 U.
Different leverage means that risk and return are completely different levels.
1 time is stable but earns little; 100 times is aggressive but requires stop-loss and discipline, otherwise you get kicked out instantly.
What really causes people to blow up their accounts is not high leverage, but messy positions and insufficient margin.
Trying to pry tens of thousands with just a few hundred U, and a little fluctuation gets you swept out.
The biggest pain in the crypto world is not losing money, but missing out after being right.

So remember:
Perpetual contracts are not afraid of high leverage, but of not leaving room.
Margin must be able to withstand normal fluctuations.
Ultimately, leverage is a magnifying glass; what it magnifies is not the market but your mindset and discipline.
Most people lose money, not because the market is harsh, but because they are too reckless.
The last sentence:
Being able to control losses at 100 times is safer than having no stop-loss at 5 times.
Perpetual contracts are not won by gambling, but by systems.
Leverage is not wrong; losing control is.

#ETH 很多人问我：永续合约到底该开多少倍？
老实说，这问题我十年里被问烂了。新手、老手、大户，都在杠杆这件事上翻过车。
你得明白——杠杆不是发财工具，是双刃刀。用得好加速，用不好绞肉。
永续合约没有到期，你不爆仓就能一直拿。
听起来自由，但自由背后就是诱惑：可以随时进出、可以无限续期、可以放大收益——
当然，风险也一样被无限放大。

#BTC 昨天一个币友说他都开 30～50 倍，我问他为啥不开 100 倍，他说爆太快。我笑了，因为只要你开杠杆，不管几倍，你都在刀口上，区别只是市场给你多少反应时间。

币圈最大的痛不是亏钱，而是看准了却被扫下车。

永续不怕高倍，怕的是不留空间。
保证金一定要能撑住正常波动。
说到底，杠杆是放大镜，放大的不是行情，而是你的心态和纪律。
大部分人亏钱，不是市场狠，是自己太飘。
最后一句：
能控住亏损的 100 倍，比不设止损的 5 倍更安全。
永续不是靠赌赢的，是靠系统赢的。
杠杆没错，失控才是。

translatedData.content:
#ETH  In the cryptocurrency world, making money and spending money are two different things. Recently, I've seen several brothers come to me crying, saying they made money but just can't withdraw it. To be honest, this is not an exaggeration at all; no matter how much you double your money in the cryptocurrency space, if the cash doesn't land in your hands, it's all just air. 

The most typical example around me is a friend who had exceptionally good luck; after a market surge, he multiplied his investment several times and was over the moon. However, when he prepared to withdraw his funds, his account was frozen, and the bank simply said 'assisting in an investigation,' leaving him unable to touch a dime for a full three months. 

The key point is that he wasn't involved in any illicit activities; it was just that his withdrawal method was wrong, causing the system to label him as a suspect and effectively digging his own grave. 

These pitfalls are not far from us; even a casual transfer could step on a landmine:
Buying OTC only to find the other party involved in money laundering can leave you holding the bag;
If a large amount comes in and you're eager to transfer it out, the system might think you're cashing out;
The most ridiculous scenario is mixing personal cards with cryptocurrency transactions; if your card gets frozen, your life can come to a standstill.
Really, don’t underestimate this; 90% of people will face it sooner or later. 
To avoid these pitfalls, it's not that hard; this is how I do it:
Always choose top-tier platforms like Binance or OKX that have strict risk controls, at least it's safer.
Try not to use USDT for withdrawals; it’s currently a major risk control target. Converting to BTC or ETH for withdrawal is much steadier.
Make sure to use a dedicated card for cryptocurrency; don’t use the same card you rely on for daily living. 

When the money arrives in your card, don’t rush to move it; let it sit for a day first, or else a 'fast transfer' might get you flagged.
It's best to operate during daytime working hours; don’t mess around at night when risk control is most sensitive.
If you do encounter a freeze, don’t panic; observe for three days as some may be system misjudgments.
If it's still frozen, go ask the bank which department froze it.
Prepare on-chain records, transaction screenshots, and chat logs; just explain honestly. 

In the end, the principle of the cryptocurrency world is very simple:
The money you earn only counts as profit when it lands in your own pocket.
How much you earn isn't the focus; being able to withdraw it successfully is the real skill.
Don’t rush to make money; first learn how to safely pocket your earnings. The road to making money is long, and getting stuck in risk control once will teach you how painful it can be.

title: ETH反转在即，比特币矿工收入创低点——数字货币市场迎关键窗口
subTitle:
近期，加密货币市场呈现出截然不同的走势：#ETH 强势反弹，牛市信号渐明，而#BTC 则承压，矿工收入创下新低。无论你是ETH粉丝还是BTC“老韭菜”，都有理由多关注这个市场关键窗口。
#加密市场观察 
ETH：下降楔形突破，牛市信号初现 🐂
过去两周，以太坊经历了一轮剧烈调整：从11月10日的3633美元跌至11月21日的月度低点2680美元，跌幅近26%。但随后价格迅速反弹，目前已站上3000美元上方，过去7天上涨约7.3%。📊

价格反弹背后，有三大核心动力：
1️⃣ 交易所供应量持续下降：根据CryptoQuant数据，交易所ETH储备已从7月初的2090万枚下降至1680万枚，为多年新低。可立即出售的代币减少意味着短期抛压下降，这对价格形成了天然支撑。

2️⃣ Fusaka升级预期：以太坊社区对即将于12月3日的Fusaka升级热情高涨。这次升级是合并以来网络最大规模的更新，预计将解决Rollup数据可用性问题，为网络扩容和效率带来利好。
3️⃣ 现货ETF资金回流：美国现货以太坊ETF本周净流入约2.36亿美元，此前连续三周资金流出累计达17亿美元。此外，Bitmine等机构持续增持，也增强了市场对长期前景的信心。

在技术面上，日线图显示ETH已突破下降楔形形态——连续更低高点和更低低点的收敛格局。突破后，通常意味着熊市趋势可能转向牛市。

下一个关键阻力位是3096美元（200日均线），若突破，目标价可指向3600美元附近，与近期高低点的61.8%斐波那契回撤位高度吻合。反之，如果跌破3000美元支撑，下一关键支撑在2750美元。📈
BTC：矿工承压，价格仍在观望 🛠️
相比之下，比特币的链上指标显示市场还未完全企稳。Puell倍数近期大幅下降，目前仅为0.67。这一指标衡量矿工每日区块奖励收入（以美元计）与过去一年平均水平的比值，当数值低于1，意味着矿工收入低于历史平均水平，压力较大。

矿工的收入主要来自区块补贴和交易费，而Puell倍数只关注区块补贴。由于区块补贴以BTC固定发放，其美元价值随比特币价格波动。当BTC价格下跌时，矿工每日美元收入下降，Puell倍数也随之下降。历史数据显示，当矿工承压时，比特币价格更容易触底，但目前距离完全企稳尚有空间。⚠️
换句话说，虽然市场有反弹迹象，但比特币仍在承压区间，投资者需要留意链上信号。BTC和ETH虽然同属加密龙头，但市场节奏并不完全同步。

总结：双轨行情下的机会与风险 🌐
以太坊：供应量下降、升级预期和ETF资金回流形成多重利好，技术面突破下降楔形，短期看涨信号明显。支撑位3000美元，阻力位3096美元，若突破，有望冲向3600美元。比特币：Puell倍数下降显示矿工承压，市场可能仍在筑底阶段。短期反弹存在，但整体牛市确认仍需观察链上指标和价格配合。
加密市场就像一场双线舞：ETH在亮相牛市前奏，而BTC仍在暗中蓄力。聪明的投资者会关注链上数据与技术面，抓住潜在机会，同时做好风险控制。💡

content:
ETH Vs BCH Technology 

Part 2 
Ethereum (ETH) and Bitcoin Cash (BCH) represent distinct technological approaches within the blockchain ecosystem. Ethereum functions as a decentralized platform, often described as a "world computer," enabling developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps) through its Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Its underlying technology is geared towards programmability and complex functionalities, moving beyond simple value transfer. Ethereum's consensus mechanism transitioned from Proof-of-Work (PoW) to Proof-of-Stake (PoS) with "The Merge" in 2022, aiming to enhance scalability, security, and energy efficiency. Transactions on Ethereum incur "gas fees," which compensate validators for computational effort and network resources.
In contrast, Bitcoin Cash (BCH) emerged from a hard fork of Bitcoin in 2017 with the primary goal of serving as a peer-to-peer electronic cash system. Its technology is optimized for fast, low-cost transactions, achieved mainly by significantly increasing the block size limit (currently 32 MB) compared to Bitcoin's traditional 1 MB. BCH maintains a Proof-of-Work (PoW) consensus mechanism, similar to Bitcoin, utilizing the SHA-256 hashing algorithm. While it primarily uses the UTXO data model and Bitcoin Script, it has introduced upgrades like CashTokens to extend its capacity for token issuance and smart-contract-like applications via covenants, though these are not as extensive as Ethereum's smart contract capabilities. BCH aims for blocks to be generated approximately every 10 minutes, with generally low transaction fees.

content:
BTC Vs ETH 

Part 2

Ethereum, introduced in 2015, expanded the capabilities of blockchain technology beyond simple value transfer. It provides a programmable blockchain platform that allows developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps). This functionality has made Ethereum the backbone for innovations in decentralized finance (DeFi), non-fungible tokens (NFTs), and various other Web3 applications. Ethereum's native cryptocurrency, Ether (ETH), is used to pay for transaction fees (known as "gas fees") and to power the network. Unlike Bitcoin, Ethereum transitioned from PoW to a Proof-of-Stake (PoS) consensus mechanism in 2022, significantly reducing its energy consumption and improving scalability. While ETH does not have a fixed supply cap like BTC, its economic model includes mechanisms like EIP-1559, which burns a portion of transaction fees, potentially leading to deflationary periods during high network usage.

content:
BTC vs ETH

Part 1

Bitcoin (BTC) primarily serves as a decentralized digital currency and a store of value, often dubbed "digital gold".
Ethereum (ETH) functions as a programmable blockchain platform, enabling smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps), and a vast ecosystem including DeFi and NFTs.
Bitcoin utilizes a Proof-of-Work (PoW) consensus mechanism, while Ethereum transitioned to a more energy-efficient Proof-of-Stake (PoS) system.
BTC has a fixed supply cap of 21 million coins, emphasizing scarcity, whereas ETH has no fixed supply but incorporates burning mechanisms that can make it deflationary under certain conditions.
Transaction speeds and fees differ, with Ethereum generally offering faster transaction processing and using "gas fees" that vary with network congestion and operation complexity.

Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) are the two largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, yet they serve distinct purposes and are built on different technological foundations. Bitcoin, launched in 2009, was designed as a decentralized digital currency, aiming to be a peer-to-peer electronic cash system and a secure store of value, similar to digital gold. Its core design prioritizes security and simplicity, with a fixed maximum supply of 21 million coins, contributing to its predictable scarcity. Bitcoin's network relies on a Proof-of-Work (PoW) consensus mechanism, where miners compete to validate transactions, which is energy-intensive but has secured the network for over 15 years.

Ethereum (ETH) Evening Trading Strategy: Seize Nighttime Volatility for Steady Profits

The evening market for Ethereum is full of opportunities and challenges. Mastering the correct operational mindset can help you achieve steady profits in the nighttime market.

Key Technical Levels
In the evening, pay close attention to the resistance level (3050-3120 USD) and support level (2980-2900 USD). It is recommended to lightly short in the 3040-3080 USD range, with a stop-loss set above the resistance level; or to lightly go long after stabilizing at 2900-2980 USD, with a stop-loss set below the support level.

Characteristics of Evening Market
The evening market has lower liquidity, and price fluctuations are often amplified, making false breakouts more likely. Focus on the active period from 22:00 to 02:00, as judging direction during this time in conjunction with volume changes is more reliable. The latter part of the night often sees rebound trends, and low-position long strategies tend to perform better.

Strict Risk Control Management
It is recommended to control single position sizes within 10%-15% of total funds, avoiding heavy bets near key levels. Be sure to set clear stop-losses, with long positions' stop-loss set 5-10 points below the support level.

title: ETH Whales Dampen Prospects of $4,000 Rally
subTitle:
$ETH whales are pumping the brakes. ETFs are bleeding out, more than 816,000 ETH are queued to unstake, and the price can't hold $4,000. The rally may be stalling before it begins.
Context in a Nutshell
Just when bulls hoped Ethereum would sprint to $4,000 or even more, the smart money is quietly turning cautious. Whale accumulation has stalled, ETFs are seeing red, and a growing backlog of unstaked ETH looms over the market. The rally may be losing steam before it truly begins.
What You Should Know
Recent data shows that while large-holder, or whale, wallets haven't dumped ETH en masse, their behavior has become more cautious. Inflows and demand signals appear muted at a time when a rally to $4,000 would need strong momentum.Spot-ETH exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have recorded net outflows, a signal that institutional demand may be cooling.On-chain stress: a large chunk of ETH supply is queued for unstaking and or withdrawal, over 816,000 ETH according to recent data, which could add supply pressure to the market if many holders decide to exit.Technical and volume indicators also show weakness: despite occasional rallies above $4,000 earlier in 2025, ETH has struggled to maintain gains or break convincingly above resistance zones, undermining confidence in a sustained climb.
Why Does This Matter?
Because when whales hesitate, and institutional demand fades, altcoin rallies lose their foundation. Without strong inflows and with looming sell pressure from staking exits, even the best-case bullish targets begin to look like wishful thinking. This could reset expectations across the altcoin market, not just for Ethereum.
ETH's road to $4,000 is getting rocky. When the smart money pauses, ordinary investors should tighten their seatbelts. Uptrend? Maybe not, at least not yet.
